headline: Almaty Saturday: Basilashvili stuns Tsitsipas, Medvedev reaches final
whyCareReason: Nikoloz Basilashvili upset Stefanos Tsitsipas in three sets. Top seed Daniil Medvedev advanced after Bublik retired.
teaser: Basilashvili d. Tsitsipas 6-4, 6-7(5), 6-3. Medvedev d. Bublik 6-3, ret. Sunday final: Medvedev v Basilashvili.
story: The semifinals at the Almaty Open produced dramatic outcomes on Saturday, 24 October. Qualifier Nikoloz Basilashvili staged a massive upset, defeating seventh-seeded Stefanos Tsitsipas 6-4, 6-7(5), 6-3 in two hours and 18 minutes to reach his first ATP final in over two years. Basilashvili fired 32 winners and broke Tsitsipas four times, recovering from a tight second-set tiebreak loss. In the second semifinal, top seed Daniil Medvedev advanced to the championship match when third-seeded home favorite Alexander Bublik was forced to retire due to a knee injury after Medvedev claimed the opening set 6-3. Medvedev will face Basilashvili for the title on Sunday.
stakes: Medvedev pursues his first title of the autumn swing against qualifier Basilashvili in Sunday's final.
rivalryAngle: Basilashvili continues a dream week in Almaty while Medvedev targets another hardcourt crown.
funFacts: Basilashvili defeated Tsitsipas 6-4, 6-7(5), 6-3 to reach his first ATP final of 2026.
Medvedev advanced after Bublik retired with a knee injury trailing 6-3.
